thread:
natasha: Cutting release now, but CI integration suite failed on canary. Holding promotion. :stop_sign:

qa-bot: INTEGRATION FAIL build/4102:
- test: payments.integration.RefundFlow -> flaky DB uniqueness violation on seed data
- failure rate: 3/5 runs in last hour
- logs: constraint violation on insert into refunds (duplicate id)

omar: that looks like the test harness reusing fixture ids when cache-restore happens in parallel. We saw similar when the shared fixture cache TTL reset kicked off multiple restores.

kevin: deploy-bot, what's the status of the canary promote?

deploy-bot: Promotion paused for redwood/payments:2026-03-24-canary due to CI failure (integration test failure). No partial prod traffic yet.

natasha: options: 1) rollback to previous canary (2026-03-23-canary-stable) and promote, 2) pin and wait for a rebuild with isolated fixtures, 3) abort window. Change window remaining: 28m.

omar: rolling back vs pinning is similar. If we pin previous canary we avoid churn. But we should record follow-up to fix fixture generation to be idempotent under parallel cache restores.

kevin: I prefer pin to last-good canary and unblock. We need release notes explaining the reason and a follow-up ticket. Safety > getting a new binary out today.

natasha: agree. pinning now. Also tagging the CI team to add randomized fixture ids and stronger cleanup.

deploy-bot: Pin applied: redwood/payments:2026-03-23-canary-stable promoted to prod/2026-03-24-rc. Rolling 100% over 2m. Smoke checks queued.

qa-bot: smoke checks: payments smoke OK. No regressions observed.

release-bot: Noted for release notes: "Production promotion pinned to previous canary due to flaky integration test (fixture id collision under parallel restore). Follow-up hotfix scheduled."

omar: action items:
- infra/ci: investigate cache-restore TTL storm and sequencing (ticket CI-912)
- qa: make fixtures idempotent/randomized (PR queued)
- release: add blurb and mark follow-up in the change log

natasha: thanks team. We'll schedule a rebuild with improved fixtures outside the current window and re-cut once green. :thumbsup:
